items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: The interviewer states 'The other musicians say that... He learned from Bunk' and 'He played music with Bunk Jones', referring to a third party ('He'), not the interviewee.

ctx.x: Then I came out of school.
Bunk was out there before you were 17? Oh, yeah. He must have gone mighty early. He must have been a young man himself.
No, no, he was. About 15 or 16 he was playing music. Yeah, sure, yeah.
